[issue by AngelOfCreation]
### Bug Description

Game crashes on launch with latest alpha.

> Crash Report: https://mclo.gs/fXDmHs9
> Game Log: https://mclo.gs/xWJcsCc

Seems to have something to do with Sable.

### Reproduction Steps

1. Install my exact modpack.
2. Update to latest alpha.
3. Launch game.

### Log File

https://mclo.gs/xWJcsCc

### Crash Report

https://mclo.gs/fXDmHs9

[comment by douira (contributor)]
Sable is mixing into our config options and is crashing because we've changed this code in the mean time by introducing our Config API. Sable would require an update to properly interact with this backport. As stated in the release notes, this is an alpha with an expected level of incompatibility due to a large amount of changes.

Please participate in testing this release, coordinating on mod compatibility, and giving feedback on [our discord server](https://caffeinemc.net/discord).

[comment by jellysquid3 (member)]
There is no bug with Sodium. The recently released alphas for Sodium 0.8 on Minecraft 1.21.1 are significantly different from the older Sodium 0.6 releases, and mods which modify Sodium's code (i.e. Sable) need to accommodate the changes.

For that matter, you should not be updating to alpha versions of Sodium if you expect compatibility with other mods that have invasive mixins.
